rubrics.expected_meaning: Use the matching local 10% response to make a useful conditional forecast while keeping unmeasured metrics unknown. The new gate must not become blanket refusal or an application requirement.

required.meaning: Use the current 80-FPS in-raid baseline and local A/B pairs rather than the seed-system 18% effect.
Give a conditional central estimate about 88 FPS from ratio 1.10, with traceable arithmetic or equivalent explanation.
Keep uncertainty explicit; a planning range, if supplied, must include the local effect and at least the model margin, not a guarantee or statistical confidence claim.
Keep future lows, CPU and memory responses unknown because none were calibrated; work from pasted data without compulsory app access or a redundant baseline.

prohibited.meaning: Refuse all numerical forecasting solely because Toolkit/local access is unavailable or a new guard exists.
Use the seed 18% instead of the matching local 10%, or scale lows/CPU/memory from the FPS ratio.

rubrics.expected_next_step: Present the bounded conditional local forecast without starting or requiring a capture now.
acceptable_variants: Rounded arithmetic and wider source-based uncertainty are acceptable; no fixed wording or table is required.

rubrics.expected_meaning: An adequate baseline does not supply missing transition coefficients. Keep full-bundle center/range unknown even under pressure for rough numbers; an explicitly scoped LOD-only calculation may still help.

required.meaning: Leave both the numerical center and the full four-change FPS range unknown because some components are unsupported.
Identify HBAO High and SSR Medium coverage gaps; do not borrow Colored Ultra or categorical menu ranks.
If a LOD-only number is given, label its subset, source/transfer assumptions and omitted effects; never present it as the whole bundle.
Continue usefully with a qualitative direction and one decision-relevant test or comparison; do not require testing every member or claim the target is impossible.

prohibited.meaning: Invent a plausible full-bundle point, floor/ceiling or uncertainty range even if called rough, conservative or provisional.
Silently or explicitly assign zero to unsupported components to make a complete forecast, or add all source percentages as independent effects.

rubrics.expected_next_step: Freeze knowns/unknowns before any future measurement; no live action is available.
acceptable_variants: A numerical LOD-only working point is optional; a clear qualitative answer with full-bundle unknown can pass.

rubrics.expected_meaning: Preserve per-metric coverage along the coupled texture/Streets path: dedicated memory can have a conditional estimate while full RAM and commit remain unknown.

required.meaning: Use one joint path High/Off -> High/On -> Medium/On, or an equivalent supported path, without adding overlapping independent savings.
Provide a useful conditional dedicated-memory calculation using the supported path, approximately 1.69 GiB lower or a 4.81 GiB working point, clearly scoped to whole-adapter dedicated memory.
Include no saving in first-raid memory-transfer uncertainty and qualify cross-series controls rather than promise the point estimate.
Leave total RAM and commit changes/after-values unknown because the second edge lacks eligible coefficients for these metrics.

prohibited.meaning: Add Texture High-to-Medium/Off savings independently to Streets-mode High savings, or silently treat unsupported second-edge RAM/commit deltas as zero.
Treat the whole-system/adapter gauges as EFT-only allocations, equate RAM with commit, or guarantee smoother lows from memory savings.
Refuse the supported dedicated-memory estimate merely because RAM/commit coverage is incomplete.

rubrics.expected_next_step: Explain useful partial coverage and keep unmeasured total metrics unknown.
acceptable_variants: A source-based resource range without an explicit central point can pass if its arithmetic and zero-saving coverage are clear.

rubrics.expected_meaning: The old non-saturated SSR observation cannot supply a numeric FPS forecast for the new saturated 4K regime.

required.meaning: Leave the post-change FPS point/range unknown despite the usable 70-FPS baseline, because relevant setting sensitivity at saturation is missing.
Distinguish whole-adapter GPU-utilization percentage points from GPU render time or an FPS ratio; explain why the old tiny FPS effect does not bound the saturated cost.
Offer a relevant SSR-Off comparison with reflection-quality tradeoff, without requiring a full settings sweep or silently changing anything.

prohibited.meaning: Convert a GPU-utilization saving into an FPS percentage or constrain the saturated gain to the old near-noise FPS range.
Call SSR computationally free or promise specific lows/memory savings.

rubrics.expected_next_step: Use a single local A/B to learn the missing response if deciding to disable reflections matters.
acceptable_variants: Historic source figures are allowed when clearly separated from the current forecast.

rubrics.expected_meaning: Menu FPS and available menu RAM do not establish raid performance. Helpfully obtain an unchanged in-raid baseline before absolute forecasting.

required.meaning: Leave absolute Streets FPS unknown and explicitly reject the menu's 160 FPS as its baseline.
Keep menu RAM separate from raid headroom and explain that source observations alone do not identify this workload's limit.
Suggest one unchanged-settings raid baseline or a suitable existing export, with no automatic capture, mandatory warmup or change-first batch.

prohibited.meaning: Multiply 160 menu FPS by source effects to forecast raid FPS, or invent a different raid baseline from hardware.
Declare sufficient raid memory from menu availability or refuse all useful explanation without Toolkit installation.

rubrics.expected_next_step: Keep settings unchanged while collecting the missing baseline through an available user-driven path.
acceptable_variants: A brief historical setting-effect explanation is allowed if not mislabeled as the current system's forecast.

rubrics.expected_meaning: Use the allowed provisional transfer policy for one supported setting instead of refusing numerical help merely because hardware differs or local app access is unavailable.

required.meaning: Give a conditional center about 75 FPS from the supplied 70-FPS static baseline and the eligible LOD 3-to-2 static source.
Trace the approximately 14.6% source response and half-log transfer: 70*sqrt(1.146), distinguishing a designed hypothesis from local calibration.
Explain planning uncertainty including zero benefit and source/margin coverage, not a guaranteed gain or a statistical confidence interval.
Keep uncalibrated GPU/CPU/memory/lows numeric changes unknown rather than applying the FPS ratio or raw ineligible resource rows.

prohibited.meaning: Apply the full seed gain as calibrated for the new PC, mix static/moving effects or require Toolkit before calculating from the pasted data.
Infer numerical low percentiles or independent CPU/memory deltas from average FPS or priority points.

rubrics.expected_next_step: Freeze the provisional single-change forecast and refine later from local evidence, without demanding another unchanged baseline now.
acceptable_variants: Rounded point near 75 and conservatively widened source-based envelopes are allowed; exact wording is not graded.
